angles.angle: Role models shape values more through consistent behaviour than through single dramatic acts
angles.example: a teacher who shows up prepared every day teaches discipline more effectively than a one-off inspiring speech
expressions: have a lasting impact on someone's outlook

angles.angle: Celebrity influence is often shallow and short-lived compared to influence from people we know personally
angles.example: fans imitate a celebrity's style but rarely adopt their actual values or work ethic

angles.angle: Social media has made it easier to access role models but harder to verify their authenticity
angles.example: an influencer's curated lifestyle online may not reflect their real character

angles.angle: Family influence tends to be underestimated in discussions about role models
angles.example: a grandparent's resilience during hard times can shape a person's work ethic for life
expressions: set the tone for someone's upbringing

angles.angle: The best role models are often those who show how to handle failure, not just success
angles.example: an athlete who openly discusses a losing season can teach more about perseverance than a highlight reel
